content: Ford F-150 pricing: base MSRP $38,500. The 15 valid configurations range from $38,500 to $59,500 depending on powertrain, transmission and trim.
Ford F-350 pricing: base MSRP $49,500. The 9 valid configurations range from $53,000 to $66,500 depending on powertrain, transmission and trim.
RAM 2500 pricing: base MSRP $47,000. The 9 valid configurations range from $50,500 to $64,000 depending on powertrain, transmission and trim.
GMC Sierra 1500 pricing: base MSRP $41,500. The 15 valid configurations range from $41,500 to $62,500 depending on powertrain, transmission and trim.

Budget tiers: Economy under $45,000 (light-duty I4 or V6 configurations with Base trim), Professional $45,000 to $55,000 (V6 or EV light-duty and entry heavy-duty builds), Executive above $55,000 (heavy-duty V8 or EV builds with Premium trim).
Heavy Duty models (Ford F-350, RAM 2500) typically have about 15% higher annual maintenance costs than Light Duty models because of specialized suspension and high-torque components.
